title: NotRexed/Hookshot
why_read: A native recompilation project that converts game binary code into native executable code, continuing a respected line of reverse-engineering work pioneered by projects like Zelda 64 Recomp.
analysis: Native recompilation is a technique that translates compiled game machine code directly into equivalent native code for modern platforms, rather than emulating the original hardware at runtime. This approach, pioneered in earlier high-profile projects, can yield far better performance and modding potential than traditional emulation. Applying it to a Nintendo Switch 2 remake of a classic game suggests deep reverse engineering work against both the original game and the newer console's binary format. This is a legitimate and technically impressive feat of reverse engineering valued highly within the emulation and preservation community.
